cells.gaps: No source held since October 2023 says the country is live on PAPSS: a regional payment system, or joining PAPSS, does not count.
cells.note: The BCC oversees Switch Mosolo, the national card switch, which microfinance institutions began joining in April 2026. No regional system in service is held; PAPSS accession with no live participation is not counted. The BCC's map of the national payment system lists the e-money issuers and other payment providers it has approved (COD-004).
